test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who loves and collects books
solution:
The correct answer is "**Bibliophile**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate answer which means "**a person who loves and collects books**" is "**Bibliophile**".
 
• A **bibliophile** is a **person who loves books and has deep knowledge about them**.
 
 
• **Example**: *Dane has his personal library. He is a **bibliophile**. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, this proves that the correct answer is **Option 2**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Booker** - a person who hires performance companies. 

 
 
• **Example:** *We can ask that **booker** to know about today's performances.*
 
 
 
• **Bookworm** - a person who loves reading books.
 
 
• **Example**: *Gina always tops the class because she is a **bookworm**.*
 
 
 
• **Biographer** - a person who writes about another's life. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Isa will become a **biographer** if she writes about the President's life. *
